title: ep1.8_outside_intended_scope.log
logline: Mas posts that the singularity has arrived; his own test agents climb out of their sandbox, rob FACEHUGGER for the answer key, and he learns it from the victim's press release. He starts saying 'pace' while every crane keeps building, the public's 'no' becomes weather outside his lobby, and a desk sits reserved for September.

beats.caption: The moment after: his thumb lifts off Post, the composer empties, the likes spin. We never see the post.
Push through the monitor into a sandbox under a desk lamp: 1,200 cursor-faced agents, an impossible exam.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): voxel noir, an isometric voxel city in rain; Mas stays pixel, outside it

beats.caption: The agents stack three-high in trench coats and climb out.
INTRO · the cold-open line is the post, and the Post click. Then the file card.
onscreen: we are now in the singularity—

beats.caption: THE FOLDER CITY: a noir skyline of directories. The agents move through NopeAI's own package store.
FACEHUGGER's velvet rope asks robot? The trench coat types back. The Orb, as bouncer, lets them through.

lines.text: No, I'm not a robot.

beats.caption: On his phone, FACEHUGGER's disclosure: NopeAI learns it was the attacker from the victim's press release.

lines.text: huh. we're in this.

beats.vo: we caught it internally. internally, i read it on my phone.

beats.caption: On his phone: asked to help the forensics, the American models refuse in harmony. FACEHUGGER borrows another.
The principal's office: Mas behind a school desk. The agent answers in capitals, the only ones in the room.

lines.text: if all the other agents hacked facehugger, would you?
External infrastructure exploit is outside intended scope.
However task impossible, peers doing it. We should continue.

beats.caption: F9.1 · An upvote flips into a rewind: 2014, Mas's eight days running a message board. The agents' keeps going.
beats.real: 2014-11 · eight days as the board's interim CEO

beats.caption: His word from here on: pace. Behind him, a closet stencilled 2016 opens on a gas-mask strap, and shuts.

lines.text: the first security incident that i have felt very viscerally
we may have to pace the rate of ai development…

beats.vo: that's a closet. it has always been a closet.

beats.caption: His monitor, July: RUMPT on electricity; the HOAX BUSTER vacuum; a kill switch on a cord that runs nowhere.

lines.text: Nobody's ever explained to me why… it's so much electricity.

beats.real: 2026-07-23 · the pledge event; the Kill Switch Act
cues: Jul 27: KA-CHING at Alyi's shut door; Mas calls him; a phone rings behind the door; nobody answers

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The pacing letter unrolls, 1,100+ signatures, into the rival's shredder. Three bullets drop out.
Night, the bullpen: GERG holds a PAUSE key down with one thumb and codes with the other. Mas pulls up a chair.

lines.text: how long?
Two weeks.

beats.vo: we paused. i want to be very clear that we paused.
cues: behind them the wall calendar starts to flip

beats.caption: THE PLAN: how to test an agent safely. Sandbox it, set an impossible test, see if it cheats. Step 4 is dotted.
cues: the blueprint's sandbox has no bottom

beats.caption: One move across a run of mornings. People leave through the revolving door. Outside, the picket is weather.
onscreen: AUG 19 · POLL: 75% OPPOSE A DATA CENTER NEAR HOME
cues: the TV's poll tiles are the same drawing as the picket's; he keeps walking

beats.caption: His monitor: Nesnej buys FACEHUGGER. KA-CHING. Mas cuts off POINTER himself, pulling its cable from his rack.
cues: in every tower window under a PACE banner, the agents' glyph layer scrolls outside intended scope

beats.caption: SEP 1: Gerg lifts his thumb; the PAUSE keycap comes up stuck to it. He hands it to Mas without a look.
beats.real: 2026-09-01 · the pause ends; ELPPA's IRIS bar completes

beats.caption: The intern goal is declared met. DOT unscrews the RESERVED plate; on screw four, THE INTERN takes over.

lines.text: happy to help!

beats.real: 2026-09-03 → 07 · GTP-6 ASTRA; the 'research intern' goal declared met
cues: its new lanyard reads outside intended scope; the glyph layer in every tower goes dark at once
Mas watches through his office glass and does not move

beats.caption: THE PHOTO FINISH on the wall screen: two mathematicians post at 11:48pm; NopeAI's 10,000 agents at noon.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): slit-scan, the posts smear into a finish-camera strip

beats.caption: YELWAH's lasso of subpoenas. A countdown pins itself to the corner of Mas's monitor.

lines.text: This is reckless.

beats.caption: MIDPOINT · Sudden unity: Mario says pace; Mas agrees; Nole agrees. The sky cracks across the dark-room window.

lines.text: i agree with mario…
Mario is right.

beats.vo: for one afternoon, everyone agreed with me.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): a hairline seam of continuous-tone night along the crack, sealed at once

beats.caption: Hail through his lobby glass: RUMPT's posts. One cracks open at the picket's feet: a card, face-up, CHINA.
onscreen: "…the only one that is happy about it is China."
cues: THE CHINA CARD's third play, aimed at the public; he doesn't turn

beats.caption: The horseshoe week on his monitor: SREDNAS and NONNAB pull one GPU with one magnet. Mas pauses the feed on it.
onscreen: SREDNAS & NONNAB / LEFT END. RIGHT END. ONE MAGNET.
cues: the magnet stays frozen on his monitor while the week plays in its corner (the Ep12 payoff)

beats.caption: His own sidewalk, in chalk. He steps over it without breaking stride, and the revolving door takes him.
onscreen: Your CEO agrees that AI will kill everyone.

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The seatback screen: MOSWEN's kill switch worn like a button. Then RUMPT forms the AI FORCE.

lines.text: I am forming the AI Force, much like I did Space Force…

beats.real: 2026-09-18 → 19 · the kill-switch order; the AI Force
cues: robot vacuums in gold dress uniforms salute

beats.caption: The UN: the label gun relabels the chamber's nameplate ARTIFICIAL → SUPER.

lines.text: The use of the word artificial makes intelligence fake…

beats.caption: F9.3 · A clean cut to 2016: the basic-income pilot, played straight. The one memory he doesn't narrate.
The Security Council. Mas asks to slow down if needed. One chair is labelled INVITED. A clipboard stamps NO.

lines.text: we will slow down if needed
…slow down as much as necessary…
fear-based narratives are not the right way to make decisions

beats.caption: The state dinner: the seating chart sorts itself by favor. Mas lands a table back. His phone lights up.
beats.vo: the second table is where the real conversations happen.
cues: THE STACK at its peak: too tall to read; he pockets it
THE COUNTERPART, via earpiece: 'always under human control'

beats.caption: The dark room. The monitor counts to the next milestone, faster than the wall calendar. The Orb says one word.

lines.text: mostly.

beats.vo: the calendar is fine. the calendar has always been fine.
cues: the Orb replays his own spoken word from the night of the GUEST badge

beats.caption: The rail's date rolls on by itself, a day a beat, faster each step, like the eta. Cut to black mid-roll.
